result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue: overlapping text on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar listing.

issues.description: The subtitle under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' shows overlapping text where the delivery time ('25–35 min') and '€0 delivery' collide, rendering as '25–35 rdielivery' making it unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Fix the text layout so delivery time, delivery cost, and cuisine type are properly spaced and separated (e.g., '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen') without overlapping.
